title: Reinforcement Learning-Based Production Scheduling in an Industry-Based Coating Scenario Using the Digital Model Playground
abstract: arXiv:2608.14122v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Production scheduling in complex manufacturing environments is challenging when sequence-dependent setup times, stochastic disturbances, and due-date constraints must be addressed simultaneously. While reinforcement learning (RL) methods have shown promising results in research, most studies rely on simplified benchmark processes, limiting their industrial relevance. This paper demonstrates the applicability of RL-based scheduling in an industry-inspired coating process that reflects practical complexities such as sequence-dependent setup times, machine breakdowns, and variable utilization. The open-source Digital Model Playground (DMPG), a discrete event simulation framework, is used to model the scenario and to train RL agents. Two standard algorithms, Deep Q-Networks and Proximal Policy Optimization, are benchmarked against conventional dispatching rules to illustrate feasibility and to provide a transparent testbed for further resear

translated_title: 基于强化学习的行业涂装场景生产调度：利用数字模型游乐场
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.14122v1 公告类型：新 摘要：在复杂制造环境中，当必须同时处理序列相关准备时间、随机扰动和交货期约束时，生产调度具有挑战性。尽管强化学习（RL）方法在研究中显示出有前景的结果，但大多数研究依赖于简化的基准流程，限制了其工业相关性。本文展示了基于RL的调度在一种受行业启发的涂装过程中的适用性，该过程反映了实际复杂性，如序列相关准备时间、机器故障和可变利用率。使用开源数字模型游乐场（DMPG），一种离散事件仿真框架，来建模该场景并训练RL代理。将两种标准算法，深度Q网络和近端策略优化，与传统调度规则进行基准比较，以证明可行性，并为进一步研究提供透明的测试平台。
tldr: 本文在工业涂装场景中验证了强化学习调度方法的可行性，利用开源DMPG仿真框架，对比DQN和PPO与传统规则，展示了处理复杂实际约束的潜力。
en_tdlr: This paper validates the feasibility of reinforcement learning-based scheduling in an industry-inspired coating scenario using the open-source DMPG framework, benchmarking DQN and PPO against conventional rules to demonstrate potential in handling complex real-world constraints.
